_readme: FIAT ORDER GLYPHS, OPTIONAL (19 Oct): the order's three keys, for the Radio's town list and chips, if those want pictures (the six rebuild materials are the expeditions' cargo icons, 29 Oct).

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_order_glyphs_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; ++ --only <name> ++ --force to reroll). Regenerate with python3 tools/make_outstanding_manifest.py.

jobs.description: A realistic painted pixel-art still-life of a single heavy brass key to an electricity substation, a red plastic tag on its ring stamped with a lightning bolt. One object centred and filling the frame, soft directional overcast daylight, natural material rendering with fine detail and painterly shading; no black outlines, no flat cel shading, not anime, not a cartoon, not a glossy video-game item; the look of a real object photographed on a grey day in a country that has run out of money. Muted cool northern palette, worn and repaired, nothing new. Nothing else in the frame, no hands, no person, no text, no logos, a plain dark neutral background.
jobs._where: the order's key, on the Radio's town list
